change_summary: The retraction notice's title names the article "Mindfulness training improves sleep quality in nurses", while the tracked paper is titled "Mindfulness training reduces exam anxiety in undergraduates". The notice says that article was retracted because its data could not be verified. The retraction is about a different article, not the tracked paper, so this alert gives no reason to doubt the tracked paper's findings.
